card.description:
You have finally reached the climax of your adventure inside the Cursed Fortress. This card represents the achievement of your final goal and the conclusion of the narrative mission. By activating this event, the match will officially transition to the ENDED state, allowing you to view the summary of your story

card.title: Complete story

card.description:
Welcome to the introduction match of paths.games.

Here you can constantly check your vital statistics such as Life, Energy, and Happiness.

Examine the movement section to discover which adjacent locations are ready to be explored.

Browse the list of available actions to interact with your current location and advance the story.

Remember that every choice consumes resources and uniquely shapes your winding path
card.title: Tutorial start location

card.description:
You are in a protected shelter, a rare moment of respite from the dangers lurking in the shadows. In a safe place, resting allows you to regenerate your statistics exceptionally compared to dangerous areas
. You will recover Energy based on your Dexterity and Life based on your physical Constitution
. Furthermore, the peaceful atmosphere will promote a significant reduction in your Sadness level. Use this space wisely to best prepare yourself before the start of the next time cycle
.

texts.longText:
Welcome to the Paths Alpha tutorial.

This short adventure is designed to teach you the core mechanics of Paths Games while you explore a cursed fortress rising from the mist.
You will learn how to manage your Energy, navigate between adjacent locations, and use your character's Traits and Stats to overcome narrative challenges. Step inside and discover how every choice shapes your destiny.

texts.longText:
Ti trovi in un rifugio protetto, un raro momento di tregua dalle insidie che si celano nell'ombra. In un luogo sicuro, il riposo ti permette di rigenerare le tue statistiche in modo eccezionale rispetto alle aree pericolose
. Recupererai Energia basata sulla tua Destrezza e Vita basata sulla tua Costituzione fisica
. Inoltre, l'atmosfera tranquilla favorirà una significativa riduzione del tuo livello di Tristezza. Usa saggiamente questo spazio per prepararti al meglio prima dell'inizio del prossimo ciclo temporale

texts.longText:
Deciding to move toward a safe place is a fundamental strategic choice for your survival. This movement will consume a specific amount of Energy, calculated based on the path cost and the current weather
. Navigating between adjacent locations allows you to position yourself tactically on the game map
. Once you arrive at your destination, you will be ready to face the new "Time Unit" in advantageous conditions
. Make sure not to exceed your carrying capacity, or the weight of your backpack will prevent you from completing the movement

Decidere di muoverti verso un luogo sicuro è una scelta strategica fondamentale per la tua sopravvivenza. Questo spostamento consumerà una quantità specifica di Energia, calcolata in base al costo del percorso e al meteo corrente
. Navigare tra le locazioni adiacenti ti permette di posizionarti tatticamente sulla mappa di gioco
. Una volta arrivato a destinazione, sarai pronto per affrontare il nuovo "Time Unit" in condizioni di vantaggio
. Assicurati di non superare la tua capacità di trasporto, o il peso del tuo zaino ti impedirà di completare il movimento
